method: WCAG relative sRGB luminance, (Llighter+0.05)/(Ldarker+0.05); channels linearized at 0.04045, alpha composited in sRGB with rounded8-bit channels. Values computed from final payload files.
scope_limits: Palette role pairs only; native app selector matches, all dynamic widgets, custom user colours and account states are not asserted.
Steam and Discord were not signed in or launched. Their native selected-state styles and role/status colours retain the app palette.
Firefox active toolbar icons are graphical cues, so the4.371:1 icons-on-grid pair is compared with3:1, not text4.5:1.
ArtCraft custom overrides are debug-only and target Studio(Dark); Pro native selection uses different roles. Release screenshots do not show these token colours.
ArtCraft alpha checks follow source tint semantics. Native debug renderer is not exercised; built-in egui global visuals may retain the base theme.
Decorative separators, document grids, and boundary guides carry no text and are not declared accessible focus indicators. LibreOffice disabled text is included for evidence despite WCAG exemption.
